start_welcome.en:
Perfect. English it is.

Great. Here is what The Brothers' Room offers you:

- 12 modules over 6 weeks
- Lessons, image cards and short videos
- Personal reflection after each module
- Short quiz to test your understanding
- A community group of men like you
- A certificate when you complete

You will learn, grow, and become a better man for your family and community.

Before we start our journey, please click the button below to take a short Pre-Test to check your baseline knowledge. It will not count against your graduation.
start_welcome.pcm:
Perfect. Pidgin it is.

Great. Here is wetin The Brothers' Room dey offer you:

- 12 modules over 6 weeks
- Lessons, image cards and short videos
- Personal reflection after each module
- Short quiz to test your understanding
- A community group of men like you
- A certificate when you complete

You go learn, grow, and become better man for your family and community.

Before we start our journey, abeg click the button below to take a short Pre-Test to check your baseline knowledge. E no go count against your graduation.
start_welcome.ha:
Perfect. Harshen Hausa ke nan.

Barka. Ga abubuwan da The Brothers' Room ke ba ku:

- Modul 12 na tsawon makonni 6
- Darussa, hotuna da gajerun bidiyoyi
- Tunanin kai bayan kowane modul
- Karamin jarrabawa don gwada fahimtar ku
- Kungiyar maza kamarku
- Takardar shaida idan kun kammala

Za ku koya, ku girma, kuma ku zama mutumin kirki ga danginku da al'ummarku.

Kafin mu fara tafiyarmu, da fatan za a danna maballin da ke kasa don yin dan gajeren jarrabawar farko (Pre-Test) don gwada ilimin ku na farko. Ba zai shafi kammala karatun ku ba.
start_welcome.yo:
Perfect. Ede Yoruba ni.

O tayọ. Eyi ni ohun ti The Brothers' Room nfun ọ:

- Module 12 lori ose 6
- Awọn ẹkọ, awọn kaadi aworan and Awọn fidio kukuru
- Iṣaro ara ẹni lẹhin kọọkan module
- Idanwo kukuru lati ṣe idanwo oye rẹ
- Ẹgbẹ alagbegbe ti awọn ọkunrin bii iwọ
- Iwe-ẹri nigbati o ba pari

Iwọ yoo kọ ẹkọ, dagba, ki o di ọkunrin to dara julọ fun ẹbi ati agbegbe rẹ.

Ṣaaju ki a to bẹrẹ irin-ajo wa, jọwọ tẹ bọtini ti o wa ni isalẹ lati ṣe Idanwo Akojo (Pre-Test) lati ṣayẹwo oye rẹ. Kii yoo kan aṣeyọri ipari rẹ.
start_welcome.ig:
Perfect. Asụsụ Igbo ka anyị ga-eji.

Ọ dị mma. Nke a bụ ihe The Brothers' Room na-enye gị:

- Modul 12 n'ime izu 6
- Ihe ọmụmụ, kaadị foto and vidiyo dị mkpirikpi
- Ntụgharị uche onwe onye mgbe modul ọ bụla gasịrị
- Ajụjụ dị mkpirikpi iji nwalee nghọta gị
- Otu obodo nke ndị ikom dị ka gị
- Asambodo mgbe ị gachara

Ị ga-amụta ihe, too, ma bụrụkwa nwoke ka mma maka ezinụlọ gị na obodo gị.

Tupu anyị amalite, biko kpachapụ bọtini dị n'okpuru ebe a ka ị nwaa Ule Mbu (Pre-Test) iji nwalee nghọta gị. Ọ gaghị emetụta asambodo gị.

question.en: What is a key characteristic of positive masculinity?
question.pcm: Wetin be correct trait of positive masculinity?
question.ha: Wacece siffa ta gari ta namiji mai kirki?
question.yo: Kini ami pataki ti okunrin rere?
question.ig: Kedu ihe bụ isi njirimara nke ezigbo nwoke?

en: A) Suppressing emotions to appear strong
B) Empathy, respect, and emotional intelligence
C) Dominating conversations in relationships
D) Ignoring gender stereotypes completely
pcm: A) Force clear emotions down to show power
B) Empathy, respect, and emotional intelligence
C) Command talk for inside relationship
D) Leave gender talk completely
ha: A) Boye bacin rai don nuna karfi
B) Jin kai, girmamawa da wayewar kai
C) Mulki a cikin zamantakewa
D) Kyalewa batun maza da mata kwata-kwata
yo: A) Mimu ibinu pam lati farahan bi alagbara
B) Aanu, owo, ati emotional intelligence
C) Jije olori ninu ibaraẹnisọrọ ibasepọ
D) Gbigbagbe awon igbagbo ti ko to
ig: A) Ichebe iwe onwe anyi ka anyi di ike
B) Ebere, ugwu, na emotional intelligence
C) Iburu onye isi n'ihe omume obodo
D) Ileghara uzo oche nwoke na nwanyị anya

question.en: Which of the following is NOT a form of Gender-Based Violence (GBV)?
question.pcm: Wetin follow for here wey NO be GBV?
question.ha: Wanne ne a cikin wadannan BA nau'in cin zarafi na jinsi (GBV) ba ne?
question.yo: Wọn lori eyi ti KỌ jẹ irisi Ijagba lori Eya (GBV)?
question.ig: Kedu nke na-abụghị ụdị ime ihe ike dabere na nwoke na nwanyị (GBV)?

en: A) Denying a partner financial autonomy
B) Unwanted comments or sexual advances in public
C) Disagreeing respectfully with someone's opinion
D) Forcing a spouse into sexual acts against their will
pcm: A) Gbanzari partner make e no hold money
B) Slut-shaming or touch touching for public
C) Argument wey respect dey inside
D) Force spouse into sexual acts against their will
ha: A) Hana abokin zama ikon kudi na kansa
B) Kalaman cin zarafi ko taba mutum a fili
C) Sabani cikin girmamawa da ra'ayin wani
D) Tursasa abokin zama yin jima'i da karfi
yo: A) Kiko lati fun alabaṣepọ ni ominira owo
B) Oro tabi ifẹkufẹ ibalopo ni gbangba
C) Gbigba iyatọ ti o tọ pẹlu ero eniyan
D) Fi agbara mu alabaṣepọ si ibalopo lai fẹ
ig: A) Ikwusi onye otu gi inweta ego nke ya
B) Okwu ruru arụ ma ọ bụ mkpasu iwe n'ihu ọha
C) Esemokwu nwere ugwu na echiche mmadụ
D) Iji ike manye di ma ọ bụ nwunye n'omume mmekọahụ

question.en: What is the most critical element of enthusiastic consent?
question.pcm: Wetin be the main part of enthusiastic consent?
question.ha: Menene mafi mahimmancin sashi na yarda ta gari?
question.yo: Kini ohun pataki julọ fun iyọnda to gbangba?
question.ig: Kedu ihe kacha mkpa na nkwenye doro anya?

en: A) The absence of a clear 'No' from the partner
B) A silent agreement based on standard social rules
C) An active, ongoing, freely-given, and reversible 'Yes'
D) Agreeing once at the start of a relationship
pcm: A) Say partner no say 'No' directly
B) Keep quiet follow what dey happen
C) Active, ongoing, freely-given, and reversible 'Yes'
D) Say 'Yes' only once for beginning of love
ha: A) Rashin fadin 'A'a' a fili daga abokin zama
B) Shiru da ke nuna yarda bisa ka'ida
C) Ee mai aiki, mai dorewa, wadda aka bayar kyauta
D) Yarda sau daya kawai a farkon soyayya
yo: A) Aisi 'Bẹ́ẹ̀ kọ́' ti o han gbangba lati ọdọ alabaṣepọ
B) Adehun lẹnu lai sọrọ
C) Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni ti o gbona, ti o tẹsiwaju, ti ominira
D) Gbigba lẹkan ṣoṣo ni ibẹrẹ ibatan
ig: A) Enweghị 'Mba' doro anya sitere na onye ọzọ
B) Nkwekọrịta dị jụụ dabere na omenala

question.en: What does it mean for a young man to be a real agent of change in his community?

question.ig: Kedu ihe ọ pụtara na nwoke na-eto eto bụ ezigbo onye na-eweta mgbanwe n'obodo ya?

en: A) Telling other men what to do without reflecting on his own behavior
B) Challenging patriarchal privileges and actively promoting gender equality in everyday actions
C) Only speaking about GBV during public campaigns or events
D) Believing that GBV is a private issue that doesn't concern men
pcm: A) Tell other men wetin to do but no look yourself
B) Challenge patriarchal powers and support gender equality for everyday action
C) Talk about GBV only for public show or campaign
D) Believe say GBV na private talk wey no concern men

B) Kalubalantar dabi'un mulkin maza da tallata daidaiton jinsi a ayyukan yau da kullum
C) Magana kan GBV kawai a lokatim kamfe na jama'a
D) Gaskata cewa GBV wani lamari ne na sirri wanda bai shafi maza ba
yo: A) Sísọ fún àwọn ọkùnrin yòókù ohun tí wọ́n máa ṣe láì wo àwọn ìṣe ti ara rẹ̀
B) Kiko fun awọn anfaani patriarchal ati didagbasoke dọgba eya ni gbogbo ọjọ

ig: A) Agwa ndị ikom ndị ọzọ ihe ha ga-eme n'eleghị anya n'omume nke gị

C) Na-ekwu naanị maka GBV n'oge mkpọsa ọha na eze
D) Ikwere na GBV bụ okwu nzuzo na-adịghị emetụta ndị ikom

module_1.en: Reflect on a time you witnessed or heard other men normalizing violence or abuse. What held you back from speaking up, and how would you handle it today?
module_1.pcm: Think about one time wey you see or hear other men dey treat beating or abuse as normal thing. Wetin hold you make you no talk that time, and how you go handle am today?
module_1.ha: Yi tunani a kan lokacin da ka ga ko ka ji wasu maza suna daukar cin zarafi a matsayin daidai. Menene ya hana ka yin magana, kuma yaya zaka magance shi a yau?
module_1.yo: Ranti igba kan ti o ri tabi ti o gbọ ti awọn ọkunrin miiran n sọ pe lilu tabi ilokulo jẹ deede. Kini o da ọ duro lati sọrọ, ati bawo ni o ṣe le ṣe loni?
module_1.ig: Chee echiche banyere oge ị hụrụ ma ọ bụ nụ ka ndị ikom ndị ọzọ na-anabata ime ihe ike. Gịnị gbochiri gị ikwu okwu, na kedu ka ị ga-esi mee ya taa?

module_2.en: What is the biggest pressure you have felt from society about 'what it means to be a real man'? How has that pressure affected your relationships or peace of mind?
module_2.pcm: Wetin be the biggest pressure wey society don put for your head about 'wetin e mean to be correct man'? How that pressure don affect your love life or your peace of mind?
module_2.ha: Menene babban matsi da ka ji daga al'umma game da 'abin da ake nufi da zama cikakken namiji'? Yaya wannan matsin ya shafi zamantakewarka ko kwanciyar hankalinka?
module_2.yo: Kini titẹ ti o tobi julọ ti o ti rilara lati ọdọ awujọ nipa 'kini o tumọ si lati jẹ ọkunrin gidi'? Bawo ni titẹ yẹn ṣe kan ibatan rẹ tabi alaafia rẹ?
module_2.ig: Kedu ihe kacha mkpa nrụgide ị nwetara site n'obodo banyere 'ihe ọ pụtara ịbụ ezigbo nwoke'? Kedu ka nrụgide ahụ si metụta mmekọrịta gị ma ọ bụ udo gị?

module_3.en: If a friend, brother, or peer close to you was acting abusive toward a partner, what is the most honest, respectful way you could intervene without causing violence?
module_3.pcm: If person wey close to you—your friend, brother, or colleague—dey treat partner bad, wetin be the most honest and respectful way you fit talk to am without fight?
module_3.ha: Idan wani na kusa da kai—aboki, dan'uwa, ko tsara—yana cin zarafin abokin zamansa, menene hanya mafi gaskiya da girmamawa da za ka iya shiga tsakani ba tare da kawo rikici ba?
module_3.yo: Ti eniyan ti o sunmọ ọ—ọrẹ, arakunrin, tabi ẹlẹgbẹ—ba n lo nilokulo si alabaṣepọ rẹ, kini ọna to dara julọ lati da si lai fa ija?
module_3.ig: Ọ bụrụ na onye dị gị nso—enyi gị, nwanne gị, ma ọ bụ onye ọgbọ gị—na-emegbu onye ọzọ, kedu ụzọ kacha mma ị ga-esi tinye ọnụ n'emeghị ihe ike?

module_4.en: Think about your most recent disagreement. Did you prioritize winning and control, or did you prioritize understanding and consent? How can you practice active respect in your next conflict?
module_4.pcm: Think about your last argument or fight. You try to show power and win, or you try to understand and respect them? How you go take show respect next time argue burst?
module_4.ha: Yi tunani a kan sabani ko rikici na baya-bayan nan. Shin ka fi ba da fifiko ga yin nasara da iko, ko kuwa ka ba da fifiko ga fahimta da yarda? Yaya za ka nuna girmamawa a rikici na gaba?
module_4.yo: Ranti aiyedeegbọn tabi ija ti o kẹhin ti o ni. Ṣe o fun ni pataki lati bori ati ṣakoso, tabi o fun ni pataki lati loye ati gba? Bawo ni o ṣe le fi owo gidi han ni ija atẹle rẹ?
module_4.ig: Chee echiche banyere esemokwu gị kacha nso nso a. Ị nwetara mmeri na njikwa, ka ị nwetara nghọta na nkwenye? Kedu ka ị ga-esi gosi ugwu na esemokwu gị ọzọ?
